project_name.justification: The text states: "...the Company has entered into a definitive option agreement (the “Option Agreement”) with several individuals (collectively, the “Optionors”), whereby the Optionors have granted the Company the option to acquire a 100% interest (the “Option”) in the Kaza and Northstar properties (collectively, the “Cyprus Project”)."

company_name.justification: The buyer is identified in the first sentence: "Prosper Gold Corp. (“Prosper Gold” or the “Company”) (TSXV:PGX) is pleased to announce that the Company has entered into a definitive option agreement..."

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO is identified at the end of the news release: "Per: “ Peter Bernier ” Peter Bernier President & CEO"

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states the company has the option to acquire a 100% interest: "...whereby the Optionors have granted the Company the option to acquire a 100% interest (the “Option”) in the Kaza and Northstar properties..."

primary_commodity.justification: The project is consistently described as a copper-gold prospect, with copper being the most prominent mineral mentioned in highlights and intercepts, such as: "Historical drill intercepts include 0.55% copper over 138.3 metres" and "Two road-accessible copper-gold porphyry prospects".

verified_article_link.justification: The provided text is a consolidation of multiple news releases and does not contain a verifiable URL to a single source article.

currency.justification: The currency is specified as Canadian dollars in the deal terms: "In order to exercise the Option, the Company must pay an aggregate of C$725,000 cash..."

cash_payments_raw.justification: The deal terms specify the total cash payment: "In order to exercise the Option, the Company must pay an aggregate of C$725,000 cash (the “Cash Payments”)..."

share_payments_raw.justification: The text provides the number of shares to be issued (1,650,000), but does not state an explicit monetary value for this share component.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and share components of the payment are listed separately, not as a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The deal terms specify the number of shares to be issued: "...issue an aggregate of 1,650,000 common shares in the capital of the Company (the “Option Shares”)..."

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No mention of share warrants as part of the transaction terms was found in the text.

option_payments_raw.justification: While the agreement is an option agreement, there are no payments specified as 'option payments' separate from the cash, share, and expenditure commitments.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.065'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is specified as a monetary value, not in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The deal terms include a work expenditure commitment: "...and incur work expenditures totaling C$2,000,000 (the “Expenditures”) over a period of four years."

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: As part of the agreement, a royalty will be granted to the sellers: "Upon the exercise of the Option, the Company will grant a 2.0% net smelter royalty to the Optionors (the “Royalty”)..."

coverage_area_raw.justification: The initial area under the option agreement is specified: "Comprised of two sets of mineral claims, the Kaza claims and the Northstar claims, the Project totals 1,368 hectares which encompass the historical Kaza and Northstar copper prospects." A subsequent news release mentions an expansion by staking, but this is the area acquired via the option agreement.

coverage_area_unit.justification: "Comprised of two sets of mineral claims, the Kaza claims and the Northstar claims, the Project totals 1,368 hectares..."

resource_size.justification: The text describes historical drill intercepts and exploration potential (e.g., '0.55% copper over 138.3 metres'), but does not contain a statement of a quantified mineral resource estimate.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are provided in the first paragraph: "Prosper Gold Corp. (“Prosper Gold” or the “Company”) (TSXV:PGX) is pleased to announce that the Company has entered into a definitive option agreement..."
